recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a woman in 1960s mod fashion reclining against a dark, featureless background, topped with a structured typographic stack featuring heavy slab serifs and a distinct color-blocked title bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds, typography occupies the top third
Red accents in clothing and boots anchor the warm color palette against deep black
Horizontal lines in the typography and clothing patterns create a rhythmic stability
coreInvariants: High-key studio lighting on the subject
Heavyweight slab serif for the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned diagonally across the lower half, scaled to fill the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red boots in the bottom left and the large white title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large white title, move down through the yellow sub-header, and follow the subject's reclining pose from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subject and separates the text from the figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background providing maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for primary text and highlights on the subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mustard yellow for the secondary title bar and vibrant red for the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows against a zero-value black background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and wide geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-bold slab serifs with thick, blocky terminals
Secondary title uses a slightly lighter weight of the same slab serif
Metadata text uses an extended, wide-set geometric sans-serif

composition.position: Below primary title, between two horizontal rules

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same slab serif family paired with a wide-set technical sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rules framing the secondary title
Small bullet points for list separation

avoid: Serif fonts with high stroke contrast

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky slab serif aesthetic of the primary title.
Matches the wide, technical look of the top 'STEREO' text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a woman with 1960s blonde bouffant hair, wearing a blue and white striped long-sleeve shirt, a short red skirt, and tall red leather boots. She is reclining on a dark surface against a solid black background. High-contrast lighting with warm skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white slab-serif title at the top center. Below it, add a mustard yellow slab-serif subtitle framed by two thin white horizontal lines. Below that, add a list of text in white sans-serif, center-aligned, using bullet points between items.

verificationChecks: Are the boots a vibrant red?
Is the primary title a heavy slab serif?

adjustableVariables: Color of the secondary title bar
Specific clothing patterns (e.g., stripes vs solid)
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Record label logos and catalog numbers
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the horizontal rules are perfectly straight and thin
Check that the red of the boots is the most saturated element
Verify the slab serif terminals are blocky and not rounded
Confirm the subject is reclining and not standing
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait on black + Reclining pose + Bold Slab Serif Title + Framed Subtitle + Center-aligned tracklist.
